title: Data folder pointer (<default root>/data-folder.json), format 1
description: Written atomically by the launcher's data-folder move or 'use this one' (kiln_manage::data_folder::write_pointer) into the default root (Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kiln, else $XDG_DATA_HOME/kiln or ~/.local/share/kiln). Read by DataDirs::locate() after $KILN_DATA_DIR and before the default. No file: the default root is the data folder. A file that cannot be parsed, has a larger format, or names a folder that is missing, unreadable or not a Kiln data folder is the error data_folder, never the default. Contracts: docs/kiln/launcher/contracts.md section 3.

path.description: The data folder: absolute, a host path, without the \\?\ prefix.
